bank.retain_mission: Extract overall project goals, high-level task breakdowns, session handoffs, subagent assignments, major milestone completions, and user preferences for workflow execution. Ignore minor syntax debugging and transient command outputs.
bank.observations_mission: Track active project progress, ongoing task state, overall architectural roadmap, and multi-agent coordination history over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize an executive summary of current project status, upcoming goals, active subagent assignments, key user constraints, and recent session handoffs.

mental_models.name: Project Roadmap & Milestones
mental_models.source_query: What are the primary goals, active milestones, completed features, and pending deliverables for this project?

mental_models.name: Session Handoffs & State
mental_models.source_query: What are the recent session handoffs, pending tasks left by previous sessions, and user instructions for the current session?

mental_models.name: Subagent Assignments & A2A Routing
mental_models.source_query: Which subagents (oracle, fixer, explorer, librarian, designer) or external A2A agents were assigned to which tasks, and what were their outcomes?
